exercises.hint: Each thread computes 100 - 60 from the same starting value — the second write clobbers the first.
exercises.task: Show the lost update: apply both withdrawals WITHOUT a lock and print the wrong balance.

exercises.hint: Each withLock call runs the subtraction safely, one after another.
exercises.task: Fix it with a lock: serialize the two withdrawals and print the correct balance.

exercises.hint: Circular wait = each thread wants what the other holds.
exercises.task: Detect a deadlock: check if two threads wait on each other and print the verdict.
